operations.title: Entry 1196 — The Residual Gram-Kummer Grade Has a Nontrivial Elliptic Extension
operations.body: Each residual triple has two connected elliptic faces and one split exact face. The two off-branch deck-point differences give generically nonzero Abel-Jacobi classes.

operations.title: Residual Gram-Kummer grade is not a canonically split coefficient summand
operations.body: Across eight terms there are 16 nonzero elliptic-face extension components. The split third face is already an exact H0-minus boundary.

operations.title: Residual elliptic-face extension audit
operations.body: Exact source pair classifications and Čech orientations give two smooth elliptic faces per residual triple. Off-branch distinct points have nonzero difference in Pic0 by injectivity of the genus-one Abel map.

operations.title: Benincasa finds a nonsplit elliptic extension of the residual Gram-Kummer grade
operations.body: Entry 1196: each of the eight residual triples has exactly two connected elliptic faces and one split rational face. The split face is the exact H0_- boundary already quotiented. On each elliptic face, the off-branch points p± are distinct, hence AJ([p+]-[p-]) is generically nonzero by injectivity of the genus-one Abel map. Thus the Gram-Kummer rank-eight object is an associated grade of a nonsplit relative coefficient system, not a canonical direct summand. Next gate is the normal-function GM derivative and intrinsic support modulo triangular gauge.
